scheme_name: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community: Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, or Jains.
Applicant must have admission to a professional or technical course approved by agencies such as AICTE, Medical Council of India, UGC, etc., in an accredited institute.
Applicant must have secured at least 50% marks in the qualifying examination.
Applicant must possess a Parivaar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
Annual family income must be at least ₹98,001 (rural) or ₹1,20,001 (urban) and not exceed ₹8,00,000.
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹20 lakh for courses in India and up to ₹30 lakh for courses abroad, with interest rates of 8% for males and 5% for females.
